bolus_model.sticky: hydrophilic — clings, accretes, draws in. Papers that HOLD onto each other and onto readers.
bolus_model.greasy: hydrophobic — slides, executes, moves through. Papers that DO things and pass on.
bolus_model.null: immiscible boundary — the SPACE between. Neither sticks nor slides. Allows things to slip into place.

sticky.description: These papers CLING. They accrete readers, reference each other, form clusters. Human-facing. The whiteboard side.

science.why: Each paper references others. Epitope chains. Anderson cascades. The science CLINGS to itself — you read one, you need three more.

sticky_clusters.name: anderson-chain
sticky_clusters.glue: Anderson localization appears in biology, soil, immunity, physics — it's the stickiest concept

sticky_clusters.name: epitope-chain
sticky_clusters.glue: Epitope sorting — the immune recognition pattern that binds everything

sticky_clusters.name: pi-chain
sticky_clusters.glue: Pi as dimensional observation, compression, inversion — mathematical glue

sticky_clusters.name: zk-chain
sticky_clusters.glue: Zero-knowledge — prove without revealing. The sticky secret.

sticky_clusters.name: membrane-chain
sticky_clusters.glue: The membrane as topology — Klein bottle, frame, diffraction

sticky_clusters.name: biological-chain
sticky_clusters.glue: Life processes — adversarial evolution, lysogeny, gossip, immunology

sticky_clusters.name: qcd-chain
sticky_clusters.glue: Lattice QCD — quantum chromodynamics on consumer hardware

philosophy.why: Philosophy is the stickiest. You can't slide past it. It clings to your thinking and changes how you read everything else.
philosophy.arxiv_map: none — philosophy doesn't submit to arXiv. It submits to PhilPapers or PhilArchive.

methodology.why: Methodology clings to everything it touches. K-NOME programming methodology, constrained evolution, prompt bank — these reshape how you build.

thesis.why: The thesis is linear and sequential. Chapter clings to chapter. You can't skip. The stickiest reading path.

story.why: Stories are the stickiest of all. You can't stop reading. Narrative is hydrophilic — it DRAWS you in.

architecture.why: Architecture holds everything together. Tower Atomic, mesh topology, ecosystem architecture — structural glue.

greasy.description: These papers SLIDE. They execute and pass through. You use them and move on. Fleet-facing. The blackwall side.

lab.why: Lab work slides through. You run the experiment, get the result, move on. The pipeline IS greasy — data flows through it.

validations.type: pass/fail then move on — the greasiest

spores.type: deployed experiments — slide out into the world

springs.type: running services — the oil in the machine

technical.why: Implementation details. You read them, you execute, you're done. Pure function.

products.why: Products are functional. You use them. They slide through your workflow.

data.why: Data flows. It slides through pipelines. Doesn't stick — transforms and moves on.

pseudospore.why: External verification — transient by design. It slides in, verifies, slides out.

null.description: Neither sticky nor greasy. The immiscible boundary. The SPACE that allows sticky and greasy to coexist without mixing. The Klein face.

trails.why: Trails are the paths BETWEEN papers. Not the destination. The space you walk through. The null that connects.

springs.why: Springs are SOURCES. They're not sticky or greasy — they're the null from which both emerge. Water is the universal solvent.

primals.why: The primals are the organisms themselves. They're not papers — they're the null substrate. The living things the papers describe.

vision.why: Vision is future-tense. Not here yet. The null space ahead of the wavefront.

observatory.why: The observatory watches. It doesn't produce or consume. Pure observation. The null lens.

glossary.why: Definitions are the space between words. Pure null. The dictionary that allows language to have meaning.

guidestone.why: Verification protocols and standards. The NULL against which pass/fail is measured.

audience.why: Audience-facing pages are the membrane surface itself. Not inside, not outside. The null face.

contact.why: The contact point. The exact null where inside meets outside.

collaborators.why: Collaborators are the Klein face — other membranes touching ours at the null boundary.

resume.why: The resume is you at the interview. Neither inside your life nor inside theirs. The null handshake.

backstory.why: Origin story. Before sticky and greasy existed. The initial null.

foundation.why: Foundation. The ground itself. Null substrate.

getting-started.why: The threshold. Not yet in. Not yet out. The door.

arxiv_endorsement_needed.description: arXiv categories where we have papers ready but need endorsement. The gate-citation.
arxiv_endorsement_needed.endorsement_model: gate-citation: you open the door, we walk through together

citation_mesh.description: The sticky clusters create a citation graph. Papers that cling form neighborhoods. The greasy papers flow BETWEEN neighborhoods. The null is the spacing.
citation_mesh.backscatter_paths: post-citation traces these neighborhoods outward — each cite backscatters to adjacent clusters
